display.purpose: Large display headers, brand titles (Space Grotesk).

serif.purpose: Rare 'handwritten paper' register — italic quote blocks, worksheet-styled surfaces. Not a hierarchy role. Playfair Display, linked in index.html and app.html.

body.purpose: General reading text, bilingual instructions, feedback scripts.

motion.name: ease-premium
motion.purpose: Modal and toast entrance/exit (--ease-premium in index.css).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button, styled in bold brand orange.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #F97316; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 24px; padding: 14px 28px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #EA580C; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.25); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary outline/dark button for passive actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background-color: #0F1014; color: #FDFAF5; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(253, 250, 245, 0.08); border-radius: 24px; padding: 14px 28px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: rgba(253, 250, 245, 0.05); border-color: rgba(253, 250, 245, 0.15); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Full-width destructive confirm button used in ConfirmDialog's destructive variant.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { width: 100%; background-color: #dc2626; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background-color: #b91c1c; } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Product Container Card
components.description: Standard container card for housing layout segments.
components.html:
Card Title

This is a standard card text content inside Chekki.
components.css: .ds-card-container { background-color: #0F1014; border: 1px solid rgba(253, 250, 245, 0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; color: #FDFAF5; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card-container h3 { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-container p { color: rgba(253, 250, 245, 0.55); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-card-container:hover { border-color: rgba(253, 250, 245, 0.15); transform: translateY(-3px); }

components.name: Bezel Modal
components.description: The app's single modal construction: full-screen blurred scrim, thin outer bezel, solid inner card. Used by ConfirmDialog and every extracted modal (ScannedModal, AcademyLogoModal, DocPreviewModal, WeekCalendarModal, ReportCardModal).
components.html: Modal content
components.css: .ds-modal-scrim { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-modal-bezel { position: relative; padding: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 40px; max-width: 480px; width: 100%; } .ds-modal-inner { position: relative; border-radius: 34px; background: #0c0c0e; padding: 32px; } .ds-modal-close { position: absolute; top: 24px; right: 24px; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #a1a1aa; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-modal-close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom-center auto-dismiss feedback, replacing all native alert()/confirm() in the app.
components.css: .ds-toast { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 9999px; backdrop-filter: blur(20px); box-shadow: 0 25px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: #ffffff; } .ds-toast-success { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); } .ds-toast-error { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); }

narrative.overview: Chekki AI features a warm, tactile notebook feel set against high-contrast dark surfaces. It combines professional, precise AI scanning capabilities with hand-drawn visual cues (circles, stars, highlights) that mimic pencil-and-paper learning. The interface is split into two primary environments: a pitch-dark, highly functional web/mobile application (product register) and a rich, deep-navy marketing homepage (brand register). This system rejects corporate SaaS uniformity in favor of rounded shapes, friendly display fonts, and emotional visual feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile Comfort: Rounded buttons, prominent borders, and soft cards.
Skeuomorphic Overlays: Highlights and correct/incorrect marks appear to be hand-drawn directly on scanned sheets.
Cognitive Clarity: Low-stress information hierarchy built to be navigated easily by tired parents and young kids.

rules.name: The 10% Pop Rule
rules.body: Bold, primary colors (Orange, Purple, Pink) should only cover <=10% of any screen. The dark background handles the structural weight; colors are reserved for interactive and feedback actions.

rules.name: The Semantic-Never-Decorative Rule
rules.body: Emerald, red, and amber are reserved for their semantic meaning (success/error/warning) and never used as arbitrary decorative accents.

rules.name: The Handwriting Offset Rule
rules.body: Any text written in the handwritten font (Patrick Hand) should be slightly rotated (-1deg to 2deg) to feel authentically drawn on the paper.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is established by color value shifts (Background at #050505 -> Cards/Modals at #0F1014 -> Buttons at #1F2937). Do not drop heavy black shadows onto dark cards.

rules.name: The Bezel Rule
rules.body: A modal is never a single flat rounded rectangle - it is always a thin outer bezel wrapping a solid inner card.

dos: Do wrap bilingual copy in containers that prevent alignment breakage between Korean and English line heights.
Do use native browser zoom configurations by keeping the viewport tag free of user-scalable=no.
Do tilt hand-drawn annotations to preserve the 'Playful Homework Helper' feel.
Do give every icon-only button and modal close control a minimum 44x44px touch target (24x24px only as an accepted exception for dense inline chip-delete controls).
Do route every confirmation and status message through ConfirmDialog / useToast - never window.confirm(), confirm(), or alert().
Do show both sides of a problem/solution card at once on marketing pages - hover-only reveals never fire on touch.
donts: Don't use generic stark blue-to-purple CSS gradient text.
Don't hide critical audience-specific entry points behind generic tab filters; stack them with clear anchors.
Don't animate image cards on hover; use border/glow highlights on the parent container instead.
Don't use emerald/red/amber for anything other than success/error/warning.
Don't use font-serif (Playfair Display) outside the rare 'handwritten paper' register - it isn't part of the standard type hierarchy.
